title: Old Fashioned Crispy Saudi Arabian Cheese Flatbread
description: A traditional Saudi Arabian dish featuring shredded Monterey Jack cheese, this flatbread is fermented, light, and nostalgic, perfect for a snack or light meal.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, salt, sugar, and yeast.
Gradually add warm water to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat an iron teppan over medium heat.
Punch down the dough and divide it into 4 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place a quarter of the shredded cheese in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the cheese to form a half circle and press the edges to seal.
Brush the tops with olive oil and cook on the preheated teppan for 2-3 minutes on each side, until crispy and golden brown.
